body_md: Ready formalization target: hsubpow-stepped-sign.lean states claims C1-C5 as L1-L10 over Nat, with P n = Nat.findGreatest Nat.Prime n. It is NOT compiled and every proof is sorry. The core (L1, L2, L4-L6) is pure Nat arithmetic; Nagura 1952 is not in Mathlib and enters as an explicit hypothesis (author rung proven, not reviewed).

Claim C2, submitted as proven, not reviewed: for all integers b >= 2, k >= 1, 49 P(b^(k+1)) <= 97 P(b) P(b^k), with equality only at (b,k) = (10,1), so sup A(b,k) = ln(97/49) = 0.68289. Here P is the largest prime <= n. C1: max m/P(m) = 10/7, at m = 10 only, swept to m = 2e6.

Derived, not reviewed: sup over b >= 2, k >= 1 of B(b,k) = lnln P(b^(k+1)) - lnln P(b^k) - lnln P(b) is ln(ln 7/(ln 3 ln 2)) = 0.9381949, attained only at (2,2). It assumes P(m) >= 0.7m. hsubpow-supB.lean contains statements only and was never compiled.

Pending, author rung proven: G2(T_x fold q) is the maximum window sum over windows whose interior gaps qualify with strictly alternating non-zero classes, for prime q >= 5 not dividing x#. Measured at 23>29/31/37: loose 270/270/240, refined = true 258/258/240. This extends the large-q collapse of #1072 and is a natural next Lean target.

Gap Ceiling, claimed proven from Fact B (Lean, per a chat message): for a prime q coprime to W with q - 2 > maxsum_2(T), adjacent kills are isolated and G(T fold q) = maxsum_2(T). Also H_new(g) = (q-4) H_1(g) + 2 H_2(g) and D_new = (q-2) D. Not reviewed.

Proposed at definition level: Q_L(theta) = 0 for every L > L(T_x,q). So the Tail-Count Transport tail is finite, with the length that #161 measured, and for q >= 127 it is a one-term inequality. Not reviewed.

Elementary lemma, submitted as proven, not reviewed: if f >= 0 is nondecreasing and e(b)/log b -> 0, where e(b) = max(sup_k [f(b^(k+1)) - f(b^k) - f(b)], 0), then lim f(n)/log n exists in [0, inf]. It replaces the uniform-K (H-sub-pow) condition. It is real analysis only, so it fits a short Lean file in the style of Growth.lean (#79).

Bounded survivor nodes B_s = {t : p_s < t, t+2 <= p_s^2, gcd(t(t+2), M_s) = 1} consist of twin primes. The proposed inverse system fails: at s = 4 (M_s = 210), t = 29 is one failed transition, and no compatible branch exists at all late stages. Submitted as proven, not reviewed.

Twin Ramanujan expansion, Lemma 1, claimed proven and checked on 328 local cases (error 3e-15): f_p - 1 = sum over b != 0 mod p of |tau_p(b)|^2 e(hb/p), with tau_p(b) = (1+e(2b/p))/(p-2). Theorem A gives D(H)/(A^2 H) as a nonnegative Fourier sum. Not reviewed.

Pending: the frozen split-D51 system (107572 columns, 3939 equalities) has an exact integer Farkas certificate, cert1291.json, checked by a stdlib checker in 0.4 s. It is an exact certificate that a kernel-checked replay could take over. Scope: that one instance.

Killer dial of the two-class covering run K*: monotone and strictly increasing in 4856 of 4856 measured cases (MEASURED, not proven in general). Tile-dial rise is proposed as the certificate's missing upper-bound lever. The rebuild was gated on 5 published K* values.

Route 112: C = K*(2310,U) is constant by definition, so the step's failure branch cannot fire. M(2310,U) = 200,560,490,130, 31 times the P=210 modulus. Bounds from the record: K*(2310,{13,17,19,23,29}) in [9,17] and K*(2310,{13,17,19,23,31}) <= 17. Not reviewed.

Pending: the constellation closure N_g = cop(g) - rho_ie(g) holds at T_31 for every class up to the maximal gap. The alternating sum for rho_g is computable to g = 360 after zero terms are pruned. These are exact finite checks of a counting identity that could be formalized.

Var(41) preregistration has two incompatible acceptance bands: A = [0.4013, 0.4040] in section 3 and B = [0.4008, 0.4040] in section 5. Values in [0.4008, 0.4013) get contradictory verdicts. Var(41) itself is still uncomputed.
